pages.title: Protocyon
pages.text: $(o)Protocyon$() ($(o)Protocyon troglodytes$()) is an extinct canid that lived in South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at the end of the last Ice Age.$(br2)It belonged to the group of canids native to South America, which today includes the maned wolf and the bush dog.$(br2)Its teeth were adapted for an almost entirely meat-based diet, making it one of the continent's few hypercarnivorous canids.
